definitions.explanation: An additional examination given to students who missed the original exam due to illness or other valid reasons, or who need another chance to pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{追試験|ついしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was absent with a cold, so I ended up taking the makeup exam.

examples.japanese: {追試験|ついしけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{実施|じっし}される→実施：03275_jisshi⟧。
examples.english: The makeup exam will be held next Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不合格|ふごうかく}→不合格：05139_fugoukaku⟧⟦だが→だが：00031_daga⟧、{追試験|ついしけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格：02816_goukaku⟧。
examples.english: I failed the first time but passed on the makeup exam.

examples.japanese: {追試験|ついしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{診断書|しんだんしょ}→診断書：28447_shindansho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A doctor's note is required to take the makeup exam.

examples.japanese: {追試験|ついしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本試験|ほんしけん}→本試験：30251_honshiken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦だが→だが：00031_daga⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧。
examples.english: The scope of the makeup exam is the same as the original, but apparently the questions are different.

notes:
FORMATION:
{追|つい} (follow-up, additional) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (exam)

USAGE:
A {追試験|ついしけん} may be offered when:
1. A student was absent due to illness or emergency
2. A student failed and is given another chance
3. There were problems with the original exam

COLLOQUIAL:
Often shortened to ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧ (makeup, resit).

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{再試験|さいしけん}→再試験：09972_saishiken⟧ - retake exam (often specifically for those who failed)
・⟦{期末試験|きまつしけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧ - final exam
・⟦{中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}→中間試験：06691_chuukanshiken⟧ - midterm exam

NOTE:
At some schools ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧ specifically means a resit for students who failed, while {追試験|ついしけん} also covers those who had a valid absence.
